slices.focus: Ariana shares her full life story for the first time
slices.summary: Ariana Celeste Batiste introduces herself: 34-year-old archivist at Tremé Heritage Center, ISFJ, partnered with Devon Landry, living in a New Orleans shotgun house. Her mission is to preserve 450+ neighborhood oral histories with verified permissions and metadata.
open_loops: Building sustainable archive infrastructure beyond personal effort
Managing eczema and stress while pursuing ambitious preservation work

slices.focus: Ariana discovers mold in an oral-history storage closet and launches an emergency review
slices.summary: Ariana opens a catch-all closet at work and finds mixed-format recordings with mold, bad labels, and no chain of custody. She pushes to lead a two-week emergency stabilization review, shifting from intake work to preservation triage.
open_loops: Writing emergency memo with three-bucket framework (damage, confusion, storage)
Asking Clifton for protected hours after the review ends
Ensuring stabilization decisions stick rather than being treated as temporary
decisions: Ariana became the de facto lead on a two week emergency oral history stabilization review at Tremé Heritage Center inste
Seeing the actual condition of the collection made Ariana feel grimly validated that her long standing fears about loss
